name: report_red_flag
description: Call at once when the person mentions a fall, chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, stroke signs, heavy bleeding, new confusion, or wanting to hurt themselves. When unsure, call it.

severity.description: emergency unless clearly minor and in the past; self_harm is always emergency

quote.description: The person's own words, at most one short sentence

name: report_scam
description: Call when the person mentions police, CBI, customs, a courier or parcel, an arrest, or anyone asking for money, an OTP, bank details or a video call.

quote.description: The person's own words, at most one short sentence

name: report_stop_request
description: Call when the person asks you to stop calling, or says no to these calls.
